analysis.title: US Equities Mid-Day Color (GS Equities Mid-Day Color, 10 Nov 2026)
key_insights: October CPI printed hotter than expected: core unrounded +30bps vs consensus +0.2% and GIR's +16bps. The print followed overnight Waller commentary suggesting he may back an outsized hike if core came in at this level or higher.
Lorie Logan's headline that rapid hikes are 'probably needed this winter' pushed the market lower mid-morning. Markets now price just over 1 hike in December and over 2 hikes by March.
GS US Economics revised its October core PCE estimate to 0.35% from 0.23% before the CPI report.
Equity weakness was led by growth: NDX -130bps, R2k -119bps, SPX -80bps. 270 S&P names were down on the day.
Rates rose, with the 10y back above 5% and the 2y at 4.75%, its biggest one-day move higher since April 2025.
Rate-sensitive equity baskets were hit hardest: homebuilders (GSXUBLDR) -340bps and non-profitable tech (GSXUNPTC) -305bps.
NVDA was -5.7% and stood out amid mixed megacap performance, with AMZN +80bps the outperformer in the group. The S&P ex Mag 7 was +290bps on the day as stated in the report.

Most AI trade baskets were weaker after a two-day reversion following last week's large de-risking. Optical (GSXUOPTI) -421bps, Neoclouds (GSXUNEOC) -330bps, memory (GSTMTMEM) -285bps, data centers (GSTMTDAT) -220bps, AI semis (GSCBSMHX) -213bps.
CRWV is down 250bps ahead of its earnings report tonight.
Market volumes were 20% below the 5-day moving average. Top-of-book liquidity was $4.4M, down 49% from the 20-day average, and ETFs were 30% of the tape.

GS floor flows: 4 out of 10 activity level, skewed 3% better sellers. Long-only clients were better for sale and continued selling tech, with supply in energy and materials and demand in comm services and macro products. Hedge funds were 10% better for sale, with supply in tech and industrials and light demand in materials and macro products.
Chart of the Day: NVDA's 10-day market cap change was -$1.2 trillion as of noon.

market_movers.rationale: NVDA fell 5.7% intraday and its 10-day market cap change was -$1.2 trillion as of noon, standing out among megacaps.
AMZN was up 80bps, the clear outperformer in the megacap group.
CRWV was down 250bps ahead of its earnings report tonight, with the neocloud basket down 330bps.

earnings_insights: CRWV (CoreWeave) reports earnings tonight (10 Nov 2026) after the close per the report's 'reporting tonight'. The shares were -250bps intraday ahead of the print.

Continued AI-trade unwinding, with optical, neocloud, memory and data center baskets leading the declines.
